title: Tremor Lab: aftershock-sequence statistics in Python
description:
Estimators for aftershock sequences: the magnitude of completeness by maximum curvature (Wiemer and Wyss 2000), the Gutenberg-Richter b-value by the Aki (1965) maximum-likelihood estimator with the Shi and Bolt (1982) standard error, the modified Omori-Utsu decay by maximum likelihood (Ogata 1983; Utsu, Ogata and Matsu'ura 1995) with a seeded bootstrap uncertainty, radiated energy and the Bath energy screen, and magnitude homogenisation to Mw by the Scordilis (2006) relations.

Ships as an installable Python package, a command-line tool, and a single self-contained HTML page that runs the same estimators in a browser with nothing installed. Reproduces a locked set of reference values for the 2023 Kahramanmaras sequence with one command.
